messages:
amy_csm: quick sync — we got reports of intermittent 5xx errors impacting EU onboarding and index writes between ~10:50-11:25 UTC. ~120 tenants affected. drafting a short customer note + remediation offer, need swift review.

amy_csm: ```
Subject: Short update — EU onboarding & indexing interruption (Mar 22)

Hello,

We experienced an intermittent failure affecting some EU onboarding and indexing requests earlier today (approx 10:50–11:25 UTC). A subset of onboarding attempts returned 5xx responses and some index writes were only partially applied.

Root cause (short): a config propagation race in our auth/control plane produced expired token handoffs for particular onboarding paths.

What we99ve done: engineers deployed a targeted fix and a safety rollback, restored normal traffic, and reprocessed most incomplete index jobs. We do not expect permanent data loss; any remaining items will be replayed with you.

Support offer: impacted customers will receive one month account credit. Renewal customers will be contacted by their AE for a tailored remediation (extensions, credits, or hands-on replays). We99ll also schedule a free 1:1 enablement session to confirm onboarding is complete and capture feedback.

If you used SSO/VPC onboarding and still see failures, reply to this thread or open a ticket and we99ll prioritize an engineering replay.

Status updates: https://status.redwood.ai

Thank you for your patience — Amy, Customer Success
```

ben_support: tone looks good. add link to support portal and a short note about how to request the enablement session.

diego_eng: RCA addendum: control-plane retry storm + TTL-evaluation race caused ~3% of EU onboarding requests to hand off expired tokens. hotfix rolled at 11:06 UTC; safety rollback at 11:18 UTC. automated reprocessing completed for ~97% of items; ~3% flagged for manual replay. permanent fix planned (PR + canary + tests) in ~72h.

priya_ae: For renewal-risk accounts, please mark them AE-managed so we can offer timeline extensions instead of automated credits. I99ll ping my five accounts after the comms go out.

marco_billing: billing will apply the 1-month credit to accounts flagged by the incident export. AE-managed accounts will be excluded unless AE requests a credit.

ops-bot: Incident logged INC-20260322-1050  severity=P2  owners=eng-oncall,cs-ops.

amy_csm: final: i'll send customer comms at 14:00 UTC and post to status page. will include support link and instructions to request the 1:1 enablement. if no objections, sending at 14:00. :thumbsup:

diego_eng: no blockers from eng. add the line: "We do not anticipate permanent data loss; we will coordinate any remaining replays with affected customers."

amy_csm: added that sentence. sending at 14:00. thanks everyone.
